items.title: A governed AI-driven development lifecycle for financial services with Kiro and AWS Frontier Agents
items.summary: A hands-on walkthrough of a governed, AI-driven development lifecycle for financial services that wires Kiro, AWS Security Agent, and AWS DevOps Agent into a shared GitHub-based pipeline, so every change is authored, reviewed, security-gated, deployed to AWS Lambda, and monitored in production with human approval and traceable evidence.
items.creator: Qingwei Li
